greeting.text: Solid Silva, Silver Eagle. Yes, those Silvas. Try not to look too impressed.
Another delver? How tedious. ...Well, at least you are not shouting.
You look like you need advice. Lucky for you I give it free. Do not expect it to be nice.
So you are the delver who keeps turning up in the reports. I suppose I should say well done. ...There. I said it.

hint.text: Water takes the shape of whatever holds it. A mage who cannot adapt is just a puddle with pride.
My family has a talent for looking down on people. I am working on it. Slowly.
Do not waste mana on showy spells. Anyone can make a big splash. The trick is being the one still standing afterwards.
My little sister turned out to be stronger than the rest of us. I will not say that out loud again.
The tide goes out, the tide comes in. If you are losing a fight, remember the tide: pull back, then return stronger.
No champions beaten? Fine. We all start somewhere. Some of us started with servants. Never mind.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun are fanatics. Fanatics make mistakes when you wreck their plans. So wreck them.
You beat Vetto? ...Tch. Fine. Good work. Do not make me say it twice.
Spade Kingdom. Dark nonsense. Wash off the curses after every fight there.
Lucius? Let somebody else go first. ...I am joking. Mostly.
People from beyond our world in the Chronicle? Splendid. More people to out-perform.

farewell.text: Do not die. It would be embarrassing for the Sanctuary.
Go on. I have things to look down on.
